item.title: Council set to start work on notorious Derbyshire road after long safety campaign
item.description: Derbyshire County Council’s highways chief has said that work is expected to begin in the spring to introduce signs relating to residents’ calls for speed limit reductions and safety measures along a notorious stretch of road which has witnessed a number of alarming collisions.
